fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It is a poor fit for careless, impatient people who dislike machinery. When a machine jams during a peak period, everyone in line watches, and impatient people become more frustrated as they repair it. Careless workers can bind hundreds of documents incorrectly.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: copy-shop apprentice or administrative support role, master various office machines, study equipment repair and digital printing, earn office equipment repair skills, then become an equipment maintenance technician or document-production manager.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits dexterous, patient people who can stay focused. Operators must diagnose and handle paper jams, misalignment, and image smearing and remain dependable when customers need urgent documents. personality_fit_block.callout: Moving from pressing buttons to repairing machines is the only viable path for this occupation in a paperless era.
